description: Evaluate a company profile against the Vault's eligibility predicates and get a THREE-VALUED answer per entry: 'eligible' (every stated gate is definitively met), 'ineligible' (a stated gate is definitively failed), or 'indeterminate' — which means WE CANNOT TELL FROM WHAT THE VENDOR PUBLISHES, and is a real answer, never a soft no. No auth required. Nothing is ever reported 'eligible' while any gate is unknown or unstructured: a missing profile field lands in `unknown` (supply it and the verdict may flip), and a gate the program states only in prose lands in `manual_review` (a human has to read it). A non-hit against a NAMED partner list is `manual_review` too, never a failure, because every published partner list in the corpus is partial. Every profile field is OPTIONAL — a partial profile is the normal case and returns more `indeterminate`, not an error. Accepts the same category/kind/status/evidence/freshness filters as ic_vault_list. Returns: { ok, total_considered, counts, matches[], notes }. Each match carries failed[], unknown[], manual_review[], missing_prerequisites[] and per-tier verdicts.

affiliations.description: Affiliations some programs REQUIRE (an academic grant, a 501(c)(3) discount).

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD for deadline checks. Defaults to today.

business_types.description: Types some programs EXCLUDE. Declaring one may disqualify you from those.

cash_balance_usd.description: Cash on hand, USD. Orthogonal to funding raised.

domain_tags.description: 'ai-native' is stricter than 'ai': the model is the product, not a feature. The corpus draws that line itself.

existing_customer_of.description: Vault entry ids you are already a paying customer of — for 'new customers only' gates.

has_domain_email.description: Company-domain email. A gmail address fails these gates.

has_institutional_backing.description: Somebody institutional wrote a cheque. Says nothing about WHO — that is `partner_affiliations`.

has_web_presence.description: Live website + active socials a reviewer will look at.

has_working_product.description: Shipped something real, as opposed to still evaluating.

headcount.description: People on the team. Checked against any entry that gates on team size.

holds.description: Vault entry ids you already hold — used for prerequisite checks (e.g. holding NVIDIA Inception unlocks downstream offers).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 of the operating entity, e.g. 'US'.

months_since_last_round.description: Months since the most recent round CLOSED. Some programs require 'funded within 12 months' — a Series A from 3 years ago fails that while passing a stage gate.

partner_affiliations.description: Investors / accelerators you are affiliated with. An EXPLICIT empty array is a statement (no affiliations ⇒ you cannot be on anyone's approved list) and fails referral gates; OMITTING the field is 'unknown' and does not.

prior_participation.description: Vault entry ids whose program you have already taken. Distinct from being a customer.

qualify.description: Return only matches with this verdict. OMIT IT to see all three — asking only for 'eligible' hides the 'indeterminate' set, which is usually where the real options are.

stage.description: Funding stage label. Distinct from the raised amount — some programs gate on one, some on the other.

name: ic_vault_match
title: Check which IC Vault entries a company qualifies for (public)
